name: Ox
source: Sancai Tuhui (1609), Niaoshou (birds and beasts) chapters 1-4, plate '牛 (ox)'; National Diet Library copy 三才圖會 106卷 [26], frame 108
treatment: genuine cut-out: an ox walking, head low, its tail swinging
fit: placed over the group: centred on its stars, upright, 8 deg on its larger side; no star tied
subject: 牛金牛, the ox of the mansion Niu: the encyclopaedia's ox
honesty: The belly line and a stretch of the back are broken in the 1609 print; the gaps are kept, not drawn in.
subject_role_note: the mansion's animal in the traditional 28-animal series (二十八宿禽星): ox (牛), the plate's own subject; the group is also named Ox
